notes.title: Minor Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have published an update contains following improvements and bug fixes:

1.Fixed some mistakes and typos on texts
2.Optimized “right-click to connect”, player can now check the status via sound and visual hints, also provides a deep-colored frame to show that two pieces can be connected now
3.Optimized mouse interactions, players can do operations like circling via mouse more smoothly
4.Optimized volume settings for easier access, also fixed a bug where volume setting will lose after exiting
5.Optimized auto save
6.Player can access Setting while on pause menu now
7.Achievement “Dream Longing”: Reduce the requirement of total dreaming time from 120 -> 60 minutes
